tonight.headline: Last brief before claims lock: Hockenson and Bass by 01:00
body: Bad news first: AVIATO are 2-5, and as set Week 8 still has Love at quarterback and zeros at tight end and kicker. ESPN projects it 98.5 to Guillo-tinas' 88.9.

Waiver claims process at 01:00 tonight Mexico City time (07:00Z Wednesday) — nothing placed after that counts. Claim Hockenson (Henry behind him) and Bass now; put Allen in and Tuten at RB before Thursday 18:15. That lineup projects about 129.4.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Guillo-tinas still start Kittle on a 49ers bye and bench Puka Nacua (22.5). Lamar Jackson, on their bench, is now expected to play Sunday (Rapoport via Draft Sharks, 27 Oct). Set properly, they are a 110-120 team, not 88.9.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A lost claim leaves the tight-end or kicker slot at zero; if so, Wednesday morning's free agents (Henry, Strange, Ryland, Little) are the cover, at no cost.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claims lock tonight · Wed 28 Oct 01:00 CDMX
doFirst.title: Claim T.J. Hockenson, drop Jordan Love
doFirst.subtitle: Likely's Giants are on bye and Chem carries one tight end: the slot scores zero without a claim. Place Hunter Henry as claim #2, same drop, ranked below. This is the last brief before the window closes.

case.label: The player
case.body: Kyler Murray's tight end: back from a concussion in Week 7 and scored the go-ahead touchdown (The Big Lead 26 Oct); 5 targets and 13.5 (archive). Minnesota visit Detroit, who allow the most fantasy points to quarterbacks (27.0 a game, The Big Lead 26 Oct).

case.label: The drop
case.body: Love's only job — Buffalo's Week 7 bye — is done (17.0, archive). Chem starts one quarterback and Allen is back; Love's own bye is Week 11, not a reason to carry him.

case.label: Contested
case.body: Yahoo's 26 Oct column ranks Henry first and Hockenson second. ESPN projects Hockenson 11.3 to Henry's 10.6; that is the call, and Henry is the backup claim, not the loser.

case.label: The cost
case.body: Chem's priority resets weekly and AVIATO sit 3rd. Order: Hockenson, then Henry (same drop — it fails harmlessly if Hockenson lands), then Bass.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Henry outscores Hockenson in Week 8 (archive), or Hockenson draws under four targets with Murray playing.

doFirst.sources: The Big Lead 26 Oct · Yahoo 26 Oct · SI (Fabiano) 26 Oct · ESPN archive

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claims lock tonight · Wed 28 Oct 01:00 CDMX
doFirst.title: Claim Tyler Bass, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: Houston are on bye and Chem carries one kicker. Bass kicks in the week's highest total.

case.label: The player
case.body: Buffalo host Baltimore at a 53.5 total, Buffalo implied 28.5 (FootballNation 26 Oct) — the week's highest. Highest-projected kicker on the wire (9.9; Ryland 9.1).

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn (93% rostered) is on bye and kickers are streamed here (STRATEGY §5) — dropping him disagrees with the market only in that a kicker is replaceable every week. If you would rather keep him, drop Kamara instead, also on bye and behind Kendre Miller in New Orleans.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Ryland or Little, both free, outscore Bass in Week 8 by more than three points (archive).

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Thu 29 Oct 18:15 CDMX — Love's kickoff
doFirst.title: Allen back in at quarterback, Love out
doFirst.subtitle: Love is still in the QB slot from Buffalo's bye. He plays Thursday night — once that game starts he locks there and Allen cannot come in.

case.label: The move
case.body: Josh Allen returns from the Week 7 bye with no injury listed (SI Bills outlook 26 Oct); Buffalo host Baltimore in the week's highest total, 53.5, Buffalo implied 28.5 (FootballNation 26 Oct). Lamar Jackson is expected back for Baltimore (Rapoport, 27 Oct), which keeps the total up. Allen 24.0 against Love's 17.2: a 6.8-point projection gap.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Green Bay–Carolina kicks off Thursday 18:15 CDMX (league file). Make the swap now. If the Hockenson claim processes tonight it drops Love anyway — but do not rely on the claim to fix the QB slot.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love outscores Allen in Week 8 (archive), graded on the outcome. Void if Allen is hurt before kickoff.

doFirst.sources: League file 22:05Z · FootballNation BAL–BUF 26 Oct · SI Bills 26 Oct · Draft Sharks 27 Oct

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Thu 29 Oct 18:15 CDMX — Coker's kickoff
doFirst.title: Set the projection lineup: Tuten at RB, Gordon to flex, Coker at WR
doFirst.subtitle: Bench Metcalf and Wilson. Tuten over Metcalf is a 2.6-point projection call; Coker over Wilson is a coin flip that goes to the projection.

case.label: The move
case.body: Tuten returns from the Jaguars' bye as the lead back (FantasyPros notes; no injury), with Jacksonville 7.5-point home favourites, implied 27 (FootballNation 26 Oct). Gordon slides to the flex, which Chem fills from RB or WR. Metcalf in a 38.5-total game against Cleveland (SI odds).

case.label: Coker
case.body: Coker 14.6, Wilson 14.1: a coin flip, so the projection decides and nothing more is argued. Coker's shoulder upgraded from limited Monday to full Tuesday (Panthers.com 27 Oct), so this morning's Coker contingency is withdrawn; Wednesday's final report is the only check left.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Metcalf outscores Tuten in Week 8 (archive), graded on the outcome.

doFirst.sources: lineup_check.py · FootballNation IND–JAX 26 Oct · Panthers.com 27 Oct · SI odds

whatWentWrong.title: Week 7 lost by 15.46 — Lamb and Pierce scored 36.2 on Monday night
whatWentWrong.lead: JuiceJam 105.22, AVIATO 89.76. They needed 20.75 from two players and got 36.2.

case.label: What happened
case.body: CeeDee Lamb 24.4 (two TDs) and Dameon Pierce 11.8 in Dallas's 38-21 win, after Barkley left with a back injury (archive; PFT 26 Oct). 8.6 points sat on the AVIATO bench (Kamara 13.2 in the flex, Metcalf to WR for Wilson's 4.6) — not enough to have won.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing about the method: Metcalf over Kamara was a 6.7-point projection call. What it changes is the record — 2-5 — and the cost of every slot that scores zero. Week 8 has two of them (Likely, Fairbairn), which is why both claims above matter more than any start/sit.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing to re-grade; Week 7 is final in the archive (07:05Z).

whatWentWrong.title: Two zero-point slots unless you claim before 01:00 tonight
whatWentWrong.lead: Likely (Giants) and Fairbairn (Texans) are on bye, and Chem carries no second tight end and no second kicker.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Houston, the Giants, New Orleans and San Francisco share the Week 8 bye (Fox Sports). Love, the Week 7 cover, is still in the QB slot.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Claims for Hockenson (Henry behind him) and Bass before 01:00 tonight, and the Allen swap before Thursday. Together they take the lineup from 98.3 projected to about 129.4.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Either claim lost to a team above AVIATO (3rd) and no tight end or kicker added Wednesday from free agency.

worthALook.name: Hunter Henry

case.label: The player
case.body: Double-digit PPR in four straight; Doubs and Hollins on IR leave him targets, and Maye is heating up (Yahoo 26 Oct). 7 targets for 14.1 in Week 7 (archive). New England at Miami, Patriots 7.5-point favourites.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Place it now — before 01:00 tonight — as claim #2, drop Love, ranked below Hockenson. If both are gone Wednesday, Brenton Strange (9.8, at least seven targets a game for a month, Yahoo) is the free-agent floor.
